summary: Verified both fixes: (1) /health and /api/health return HTTP 200 quickly under all conditions with proper degraded-DB fallback; (2) complaint form UI now uses 'characters' instead of 'words' in placeholder and counter, and validation logic checks characters >= 20. Regression test for pending-order cleanup still 100% passing.

minor.issue: When DB times out via asyncio.wait_for, str(TimeoutError()) is empty string, so response reads 'degraded: ' with trailing empty message. Functionally correct (200 in ~1.00s) but cosmetically the reason is missing. Consider: `except asyncio.TimeoutError: return {..., 'database': 'degraded: ping timeout (>1s)'}` and keep the generic Exception branch for other failures.
Duplicated implementation between bare /health and api_router /health (lines 75-89 vs 91-99). Extract into a shared helper to avoid divergence.

health_degraded_response_times.notes: Timings ~1.00s confirm asyncio.wait_for(timeout=1.0) is enforced correctly. All well under 1.2s (spec) and 2s (probe budget). Simulated by setting MONGO_URL=mongodb://invalid-host-nonexistent:27017 and restarting backend.

verification_details.mongo_url_restore: MONGO_URL restored from .env.bak; diff .env .env.bak clean; backend reconnected (log: 'Connected to MongoDB successfully'); /health returns database=connected in 1.6ms.

action_items: (Minor, optional) Improve degraded-DB message: catch asyncio.TimeoutError separately so response says 'degraded: ping timeout (>1s)' rather than 'degraded: '.
(Minor, optional) DRY the two health handlers into one shared helper.
critical_code_review_comments: Health fix is correct and minimal — always returns 200, wraps only the ping call in asyncio.wait_for, correct 1.0s bound observed in real timing tests.
Frontend fix is complete: source, .next server bundle, and .next static client bundle all use 'characters'; validation uses `.trim().length < 20` matching the UX copy.
No regressions: order cleanup pytest still 100% passing.
Consider adding a lightweight backend integration test for the degraded-DB path (mock db.command to raise asyncio.TimeoutError and assert 200 + degraded response) so this can't regress silently.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Both P0 (health) and P1 (complaint copy) fixes verified end-to-end. The health endpoint hits the 1.0s wait_for ceiling within a few ms — no CPU headroom worry. If further UX testing of the complaint modal is required, seed a customer via POST /api/auth/customer/register (or the existing OTP flow) since /app/memory/test_credentials.md has no customer credentials.
rca of the issue: N/A — this was a verification pass on already-applied fixes. Root cause of prior issues: (1) unbounded db.command('ping') could hang > readiness probe budget on slow MongoDB Atlas; fixed by asyncio.wait_for(1.0). (2) Copy said 'words' while validator counted characters; fixed by aligning copy with existing character-based validator.
